body.name: Simultaneous LR profile band
body.construction: For the eventual-regime feasible critical value \(\widehat q_{n,\alpha}\), with its \(+\infty\) convention when \(\widehat T_n<T_0\), set \(\mathcal C_n(a)=\{t:Q_n(a,t)\le\widehat\kappa(a)\widehat q_{n,\alpha}\}\) and extend data-cell endpoints monotonically over \(J\).
